About the data

Value created
Market capitalization at year-end 2024, from CompaniesMarketCap: a snapshot of equity value that moves with the share price. Many people built each company; each profile highlights one leader.
People employed
Direct employees of the company and its subsidiaries, including through acquisitions, from annual reports and Stock Analysis, generally for fiscal 2024 or the first half of 2025. Where reporting overlaps, some people may be counted twice.
Estimated annual pay
Our estimate: people employed × an assumed yearly pay per person in USD, set by industry and in some cases home country. Actual pay varies by role and location.
Locations
Globes show selected locations; employment and pay cover people worldwide. Amazon adds net sales by market, U.S. state investment, jobs and estimated GDP contributions, and selected facilities. Geography: Natural Earth; U.S. states: Census Bureau via US Atlas.

A fixed 2024–25 snapshot. Each profile links its sources, photo credits and licenses. Discussion that inspired the list
